prompt: Create a complete portfolio website for a contemporary digital artist named Alex Rivera. The site should showcase their work in generative art, interactive installations, and digital sculptures. Include: 1) A landing page with hero section and navigation, 2) An about page with artist bio and statement, 3) A gallery page displaying 6 artwork pieces with titles and descriptions, 4) A contact page with form and social links. The design must be visually striking with a distinctive aesthetic that reflects cutting-edge digital art culture. Use modern web technologies (HTML/CSS/JS) and ensure the site is fully functional. Save the main page as 'index.html' and create separate files for other pages. Include a README.md file explaining the design concept and aesthetic choices.
